name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-07-02, at wavelengths from 0.92 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
